dialogue_inspector.speaker: Inspector
lines: Tickets ready? The hills are waiting beyond the station.
Follow the line carefully, Tenzing. Every stop has a story.

dialogue_boatman.speaker: Boatman
lines: Mirik Lake is quiet when the mist comes down.
The boats move slowly here, but every crossing points back toward the hills.
Walk with the weather, Tenzing. The lake teaches patience before the road climbs again.

dialogue_old_traveler.speaker: Old Traveler
lines: Rohini road rises quietly, one bend after another.
The hills do not hurry. Listen to the wind, watch the banners, and keep your steps steady.
By the time the signpost appears, the mist will already know where you are going.

dialogue_tea_worker.speaker: Tea Worker
lines: The tea gardens wake before the town does.
Darjeeling is best understood one careful step at a time.

dialogue_darjeeling_tea_worker.speaker: Tea Worker
lines: Darjeeling runs on tea, footsteps, and the hum of the hills.
Mall Road stays busy, but the town still moves at mountain pace.
When you watch the gardens and the people together, hill-town life starts to make sense.

dialogue_monk.speaker: Monk
lines: At Ghoom, the clouds feel close enough to touch.

dialogue_guide_trail.speaker: Guide
lines: The Sandakphu trail is beautiful, but it asks for patience.
Keep your breath steady and your eyes on the ridge.

dialogue_guide_summit.speaker: Guide
lines: You made it to the summit.
From here, the clouds are not above you anymore.
